candidates.title: EIA expects record electricity generation in 2026 and 2027
candidates.summary: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) expects U.S. electricity generation will grow 2.2% to a record 4,368 billion kilowatthours (BkWh) this year. EIA expects an additional 1.7% growth in electricity generation next year.

candidates.title: Civilians bear the brunt, with deadly US strikes in Iran and thousands displaced in Yemen
candidates.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators called for an immediate cessation of hostilities on Monday following a series of United States airstrikes on Iran in recent weeks that have killed civilians as tensions ripple through the region.

candidates.title: IAEA chief underscores commitment to nuclear safety and verification
candidates.summary: The Director General of the UN nuclear watchdog, IAEA, opened its 70th General Conference on Monday in Vienna with a message full of optimism, stressing that despite the many difficulties and tensions the world is witnessing a “common spirit of dedication” which still guides their work.

candidates.title: South Sudan: UNICEF reaches communities cut off by conflict in Jonglei state
candidates.summary: The UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) and partners have delivered lifesaving assistance to families in conflict-affected communities in South Sudan’s Jonglei state, many of whom had gone months without humanitarian support.

candidates.title: Guterres urges leaders to invest in peace as conflicts deepen
candidates.summary: The UN Secretary-General appealed on Wednesday for world leaders to invest in peace as violence, division and conflict exacerbate suffering worldwide.&nbsp;
